remarks: Bright & airy! Large studio/1 bed unit in quiet courtyard setting in the heart of vibrant Stamford. Walking distance to shops, restaurants, train station & shopping mall. The unit offers 9ft. ceilings, hardwood floors throughout, a welcoming foyer, private "bedroom" (see pictures), airy living room, dining room area, renovated kitchen with granite counter-top, huge walk-in closet and built-ins. The Complex is well maintained, and simply beautiful. Unit comes with one parking spot, Garage parking ($40 per spot) and free guest parking is available. Heat, hot water included. The two beautiful courtyards are as charming as can be and a true oasis in the heart of Stamford.
